     <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis plus upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus 2 x squared plus x plus 2" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis plus upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus 2 x squared plus x plus 2](images/c03_468.png)
    
     <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis asterisk upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x Superscript 5 Baseline plus x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x cubed plus 2 x squared plus x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>\*</mo><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis asterisk upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x Superscript 5 Baseline plus x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x cubed plus 2 x squared plus x plus 1](images/c03_469.png)
    
*   – Computations over  <math alttext="double-struck upper Z 2" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></math> ![double-struck upper Z 2](images/c03_470.png):

 <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis minus upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus x" display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis minus upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus x](images/c03_471.png)

xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo minus upper R left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_480.png)*. The congruence relation is denoted*  <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper R left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis period" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mi>R</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>.</mo></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper R left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis period](images/c03_481.png)

**Example 3.29**

*   –  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis identical-to question-mark m o d left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>&#8801;</mo><mo>?</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis identical-to question-mark m o d left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis](images/c03_482.png) in  <math alttext="double-struck upper Z 2 left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![double-struck upper Z 2 left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_483.png)
    
    Since  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis equals x squared plus 2 x plus 1 comma left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis identical-to 0 m o d left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>\*</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>0</mn><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis equals x squared plus 2 x plus 1 comma left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis identical-to 0 m o d left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis](images/c03_484.png)
    
*   –  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis identical-to question-mark m o d left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>&#8801;</mo><mo>?</mo><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis identical-to question-mark m o d left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis](images/c03_485.png) in  <math alttext="double-struck upper Z 3 left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![double-struck upper Z 3 left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_486.png)
    
    Since  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x minus 1 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis plus 2 equals x squared plus 1 comma left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis identical-to 2 m o d left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>\*</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x minus 1 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis plus 2 equals x squared plus 1 comma left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis identical-to 2 m o d left-parenthesis x plus 1 right-parenthesis](images/c03_487.png)
    
*   –  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 right-parenthesis identical-to left-parenthesis question-mark right-parenthesis m o d left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>&#8801;</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>?</mo><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 right-parenthesis identical-to left-parenthesis question-mark right-parenthesis m o d left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis](images/c03_488.png) in  <math alttext="double-struck upper Z 101 left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mrow><mn>101</mn></mrow></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![double-struck upper Z 101 left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_489.png)
    
     <math alttext="left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis x plus 9 right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus 11 x squared plus 27 x plus 81" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>\*</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>27</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>81</mn></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis x plus 9 right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus 11 x squared plus 27 x plus 81](images/c03_490.png)
    
     <math alttext="equals x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 plus left-parenthesis 26 x plus 74 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>+</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>26</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>74</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![equals x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 plus left-parenthesis 26 x plus 74 right-parenthesis](images/c03_491.png)
    
    Hence,  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 right-parenthesis identical-to minus left-parenthesis 26 x plus 74 right-parenthesis m o d left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>&#8801;</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>26</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>74</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 right-parenthesis identical-to minus left-parenthesis 26 x plus 74 right-parenthesis m o d left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis](images/c03_492.png)
    
*   –  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 right-parenthesis identical-to left-parenthesis question-mark right-parenthesis m o d left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>&#8801;</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo>?</mo><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 right-parenthesis identical-to left-parenthesis question-mark right-parenthesis m o d left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis](images/c03_493.png) in  <math alttext="double-struck upper Z 13 left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mrow><mn>13</mn></mrow></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![double-struck upper Z 13 left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_494.png)
    
    In  <math alttext="double-struck upper Z 13 comma minus left-parenthesis 26 x plus 74 right-parenthesis equals minus left-parenthesis 2 asterisk 13 x plus 5 asterisk 13 plus 9 right-parenthesis identical-to negative 9 m o d 13 equals 4" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mrow><mn>13</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>26</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>74</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>9</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>13</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></math> ![double-struck upper Z 13 comma minus left-parenthesis 26 x plus 74 right-parenthesis equals minus left-parenthesis 2 asterisk 13 x plus 5 asterisk 13 plus 9 right-parenthesis identical-to negative 9 m o d 13 equals 4](images/c03_495.png)
    
    Hence,  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 right-parenthesis identical-to 4 m o d left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x cubed plus 11 x squared plus x plus 7 right-parenthesis identical-to 4 m o d left-parenthesis x squared plus 2 x plus 9 right-parenthesis](images/c03_496.png)

The following properties hold:

1.   <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_499.png)
2.  If  <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_500.png), then  <math alttext="upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_501.png)
3.  If  <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis a n d upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper C left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>a</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mi>C</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis a n d upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper C left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_502.png), then
    
     <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper C left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mi>C</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper C left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_503.png)
    
4.  If  <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper A 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis a n d upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>a</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper A 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis a n d upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_504.png), then
    
     <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis plus upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to left-parenthesis upper A 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis plus upper B 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>B</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis plus upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to left-parenthesis upper A 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis plus upper B 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_505.png) *and*
    
     <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis asterisk upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to left-parenthesis upper A 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis asterisk upper B 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>\*</mo><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>\*</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis asterisk upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to left-parenthesis upper A 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis asterisk upper B 1 left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_506.png)
    
5.  If  <math alttext="upper A Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis comma for i equals 1 comma 2 comma ellipsis comma k" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;for&#160;</mtext><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>&#8230;</mo><mo>,</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></math> ![upper A Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis comma for i equals 1 comma 2 comma ellipsis comma k](images/c03_507.png), then

     <math alttext="product Underscript i equals 1 Overscript k Endscripts upper A Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to product Underscript i equals 1 Overscript k Endscripts upper B Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><msubsup><mo>&#8719;</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>k</mi></msubsup><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><msubsup><mo>&#8719;</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mi>k</mi></msubsup><mrow><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mstyle></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math> ![product Underscript i equals 1 Overscript k Endscripts upper A Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to product Underscript i equals 1 Overscript k Endscripts upper B Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_509.png)
    
     <math alttext="upper A Subscript j Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis minus upper A Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B Subscript j Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis minus upper B Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis comma 1 less-than-or-equal-to i less-than-or-equal-to k comma 1 less-than-or-equal-to j less-than-or-equal-to k" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>A</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>j</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>1</mn><mo>&#8804;</mo><mi>i</mi><mo>&#8804;</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>1</mn><mo>&#8804;</mo><mi>j</mi><mo>&#8804;</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></math> ![upper A Subscript j Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis minus upper A Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis identical-to upper B Subscript j Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis minus upper B Subscript i Baseline left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis m o d upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis comma 1 less-than-or-equal-to i less-than-or-equal-to k comma 1 less-than-or-equal-to j less-than-or-equal-to k](images/c03_510.png)
    

***Definition 3.35 Polynomial root***:  <math alttext="a element-of double-struck upper Z Subscript p Baseline" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>&#8712;</mo><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></math> ![a element-of double-struck upper Z Subscript p Baseline](images/c03_511.png)*is a root of polynomial*  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_512.png), *if*  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis a right-parenthesis equals 0" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis a right-parenthesis equals 0](images/c03_513.png)*. Therefore, if* *a* *is a root of*  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_514.png)*, there exists a polynomial*  <math alttext="g left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>g</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![g left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_515.png) *of degree less than that of*  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_516.png)*, such that*  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis x minus a right-parenthesis asterisk g left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>\*</mo><mi>g</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis x minus a right-parenthesis asterisk g left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_517.png).

***Definition 3.36 Irreducible polynomial***: *a polynomial*  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_518.png) *is said to be irreducible in* ℤ[p] *if it does not factor as a product of two or more polynomials with coefficients in* ℤ[p] *each of degree less than that of*  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_519.png).

In other words, an irreducible polynomial over ℤ[p] has no root in ℤ[p]. Irreducible polynomials are counterpart of primes: irreducible polynomials cannot be expressed as a product of two other polynomials like primes cannot be factorized. Therefore, irreducible polynomials are used as polynomial moduli to construct finite fields.

In general, if a polynomial has no root, it does not necessarily mean that it is irreducible. For example, in  <math alttext="double-struck upper Z 3" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></mrow></math> ![double-struck upper Z 3](images/c03_525.png),  <math alttext="x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x squared plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></math> ![x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x squared plus 1](images/c03_526.png) can be written as a product  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis](images/c03_527.png). Therefore, it is reducible, but it has no roots in  <math alttext="double-struck upper Z 3" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></mrow></math> ![double-struck upper Z 3](images/c03_528.png), because  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x squared plus 1 right-parenthesis](images/c03_529.png) has no roots in  <math alttext="double-struck upper Z 3" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>&#8484;</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></mrow></math> ![double-struck upper Z 3](images/c03_530.png).

**Example 3.30**

*   – Reducible polynomial over  <math alttext="upper F 2" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F 2](images/c03_531.png):  <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x squared plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x squared plus 1](images/c03_532.png).
    
    Since  <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis 1 right-parenthesis equals 0" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis 1 right-parenthesis equals 0](images/c03_533.png),  <math alttext="1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></math> ![1](images/c03_534.png) is a root; and  <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_535.png) can be written as a product, i.e.  <math alttext="x squared plus 1 equals left-parenthesis x minus 1 right-parenthesis left-parenthesis x minus 1 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![x squared plus 1 equals left-parenthesis x minus 1 right-parenthesis left-parenthesis x minus 1 right-parenthesis](images/c03_536.png).
    
*   – Reducible polynomial over  <math alttext="upper F 5" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F 5](images/c03_537.png):
    
     <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x cubed plus 3 x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x cubed plus 3 x plus 1](images/c03_538.png).
    
    Since  <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis 3 right-parenthesis equals 145 identical-to 0 m o d 5" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>145</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>0</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>5</mn></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis 3 right-parenthesis equals 145 identical-to 0 m o d 5](images/c03_539.png), 3 is a root; and  <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_540.png) can be written as a product, i.e.  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x minus 3 right-parenthesis left-parenthesis x cubed plus 3 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis x plus 2 right-parenthesis left-parenthesis x cubed plus 3 right-parenthesis equals x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x cubed plus 3 x plus 6 equals x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x cubed plus 3 x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>=</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x minus 3 right-parenthesis left-parenthesis x cubed plus 3 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis x plus 2 right-parenthesis left-parenthesis x cubed plus 3 right-parenthesis equals x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x cubed plus 3 x plus 6 equals x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 2 x cubed plus 3 x plus 1](images/c03_541.png).
    
*   – Irreducible polynomials over  <math alttext="upper F 2" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F 2](images/c03_542.png)
    
     <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x squared plus x plus 1 colon upper P left-parenthesis 0 right-parenthesis equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>:</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x squared plus x plus 1 colon upper P left-parenthesis 0 right-parenthesis equals 1](images/c03_543.png) and  <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis 1 right-parenthesis equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis 1 right-parenthesis equals 1](images/c03_544.png). Thus,  <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_545.png) has no root over  <math alttext="upper F 2" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F 2](images/c03_546.png). Hence, by Theorem 3.14,  <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_547.png) is irreducible.
    
     <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x Superscript 4 Baseline plus x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper R left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_550.png) of degree less than 4 such that  <math alttext="upper P xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![x squared plus 1](images/c03_555.png),  <math alttext="x squared plus x plus 1" plus 1](images/c03_557.png),  <math alttext="x cubed plus x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![x cubed plus x plus 1](images/c03_558.png), and  <math alttext="x cubed plus x squared plus x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![x cubed plus x squared plus x plus 1](images/c03_559.png). No product of a pair of candidate polynomials results in  <math alttext="upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper P left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_560.png). Therefore, the latter is irreducible.
    

#### *3.2.3.2 Representation of Finite Fields as Polynomials*

The general representation of elements of a field  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m](images/c03_561.png), with prime *p*, is a polynomial basis representation, in which a distinct polynomial of degree less than *m* is associated with each element of the field  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m](images/c03_562.png). That is, each element  <math alttext="a element-of upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>&#8712;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![a element-of upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline](images/c03_563.png) has a unique polynomial  <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_564.png) with degree less than *m*. For example,  <math alttext="a equals 2 element-of upper F Subscript 2 Sub Superscript 4" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>&#8712;</mo><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![a equals 2 element-of upper F Subscript 2 Sub Superscript 4](images/c03_565.png) and  <math alttext="b equals 13 element-of upper F Subscript 2 Sub Superscript 4" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8712;</mo><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![b equals 13 element-of upper F Subscript 2 Sub Superscript 4](images/c03_566.png) are represented by  <math alttext="upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></math> ![upper A left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x](images/c03_567.png) and  <math alttext="upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus x squared plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>B</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper B left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus x squared plus 1](images/c03_568.png), respectively, because  <math alttext="2 equals 2 Superscript 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>1</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![2 equals 2 Superscript 1](images/c03_569.png) and  <math alttext="13 equals 2 cubed plus 2 squared plus 2 Superscript 0" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>13</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>0</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![13 equals 2 cubed plus 2 squared plus 2 Superscript 0](images/c03_570.png).

Let  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_571.png) denote the set of polynomials of degree less than *m* with coefficients in *F[p]*.

**Note.**  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Subscript Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket slash f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Subscript Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket slash f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_573.png) denotes the set of polynomials yielded by operations modulo *f(x)* on polynomials in the set  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_574.png). Addition of two polynomials is done by usual polynomial addition with modulo *p* on the coefficients. Multiplication of two polynomials is performed with modulo *f(x)* on the usual product of two polynomials.

***Definition 3.37 Reduction polynomial****: the irreducible polynomial* *f(x)used to reduce the product of polynomials in*  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_575.png) *is called reduction polynomial*.

#### *3.2.3.3 Construction of Finite Fields as Polynomials*

***Definition 3.38 Primitive polynomial***:  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_586.png)*, a polynomial of degree* *m, irreducible in*  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mi>p</mi></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_587.png)*, and with coefficients in* *F[p], is said to be primitive polynomial if it has a root*  <math alttext="alpha element-of upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>&#8712;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![alpha element-of upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m Baseline](images/c03_588.png) *such that*  <math alttext="StartSet 0 comma 1 comma alpha comma alpha squared comma alpha comma Superscript 3 Baseline ellipsis comma alpha Superscript p Super Superscript m minus 2 Superscript Baseline EndSet" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><msup><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>&#8230;</mo><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow></math> ![StartSet 0 comma 1 comma alpha comma alpha squared comma alpha comma Superscript 3 Baseline ellipsis comma alpha Superscript p Super Superscript m minus 2 Superscript Baseline EndSet](images/c03_589.png) *is the entire field*  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m](images/c03_590.png)*. In other words, a root of a primitive polynomial is a field generator*.

**Example 3.32**

Below is a non-comprehensive list of primitive polynomials with degree up to 32.

![](images/c03_591.png)

The consequence of Theorem 3.19 is that given a root α of a primitive polynomial  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_621.png) of degree *m* and with coefficients in *F[p]*, we can generate all elements of the extension field  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m](images/c03_622.png) as powers of α modulo  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_623.png).

**Example 3.33**  Let  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus x plus 1](images/c03_624.png) be a primitive polynomial over  <math alttext="upper F 2 left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper F 2 left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_625.png). According to Theorem 3.19,  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_626.png) has three roots  <math alttext="alpha comma alpha squared" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![alpha comma alpha squared](images/c03_627.png), and  <math alttext="alpha Superscript 4" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![alpha Superscript 4](images/c03_628.png) in  <math alttext="upper F Subscript 2 cubed Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript 2 cubed Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket](images/c03_629.png). By definition of a root, if α is a root of  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_630.png), then  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis alpha right-parenthesis equals alpha cubed plus alpha plus 1 equals 0" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis alpha right-parenthesis equals alpha cubed plus alpha plus 1 equals 0](images/c03_631.png) in  <math alttext="upper F Subscript 2 cubed Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket slash f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></msub><mrow><mo>\[</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>\]</mo></mrow><mo>/</mo><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript 2 cubed Baseline left-bracket x right-bracket slash f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_632.png).

Let us show that if  <math alttext="alpha equals 2" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></math> ![alpha equals 2](images/c03_633.png) is a root, then  <math alttext="alpha squared" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![alpha squared](images/c03_634.png) and  <math alttext="alpha Superscript 4" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![alpha Superscript 4](images/c03_635.png) are roots, too.

Since operations in extension fields are done modulo the reduction polynomial  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_636.png),  <math alttext="x cubed plus x plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>0</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![x cubed plus x plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_637.png).

Since  <math alttext="alpha equals x" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></math> ![alpha equals x](images/c03_638.png),  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis alpha squared right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis x squared right-parenthesis cubed plus x squared plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis alpha squared right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis x squared right-parenthesis cubed plus x squared plus 1](images/c03_639.png)  <math alttext="equals x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x squared plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>=</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>6</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>0</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![equals x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x squared plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_640.png). Hence,  <math alttext="alpha squared" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![alpha squared](images/c03_641.png) is a root to  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_642.png).

 <math alttext="f left-parenthesis alpha Superscript 4 Baseline right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis alpha Superscript 4 Baseline right-parenthesis cubed plus alpha Superscript 4 Baseline plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis alpha Superscript 4 Baseline right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis alpha Superscript 4 Baseline right-parenthesis cubed plus alpha Superscript 4 Baseline plus 1](images/c03_643.png).

Since  <math alttext="alpha equals x" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></math> ![alpha equals x](images/c03_644.png),  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis alpha Superscript 4 Baseline right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis x Superscript 4 Baseline right-parenthesis cubed plus x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 1 equals x Superscript 12 Baseline plus x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow><mn>12</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis alpha Superscript 4 Baseline right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis x Superscript 4 Baseline right-parenthesis cubed plus x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 1 equals x Superscript 12 Baseline plus x Superscript 4 Baseline plus 1](images/c03_645.png)  <math alttext="identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>0</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_646.png). Hence,  <math alttext="alpha Superscript 4" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![alpha Superscript 4](images/c03_647.png) is a root to  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_648.png). Notice that:  <math alttext="x Superscript 4 Baseline identical-to x squared plus x m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![x Superscript 4 Baseline identical-to x squared plus x m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_649.png).

Polynomials *x*,  <math alttext="x squared" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![x squared](images/c03_650.png), and  <math alttext="x squared plus x" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></math> ![x squared plus x](images/c03_651.png) represent elements 2, 4, and 6 in  <math alttext="upper F Subscript 2 cubed" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript 2 cubed](images/c03_652.png), respectively.

Let us check the roots above:

  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals 2 cubed plus 2 plus 1 equals 11" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>11</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals 2 cubed plus 2 plus 1 equals 11](images/c03_653.png) is represented by polynomial  <math alttext="x cubed plus x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![x cubed plus x plus 1](images/c03_654.png). Since,  <math alttext="x cubed plus x plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>0</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![x cubed plus x plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_655.png),  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals 0" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals 0](images/c03_656.png).

  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis 4 right-parenthesis equals 4 cubed plus 4 plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>4</mn><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis 4 right-parenthesis equals 4 cubed plus 4 plus 1](images/c03_657.png) is represented by polynomial  <math alttext="x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x squared plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>6</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x squared plus 1](images/c03_658.png). Since,  <math alttext="x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x squared plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>6</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>0</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x squared plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_659.png),  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis 4 right-parenthesis equals 0" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis 4 right-parenthesis equals 0](images/c03_660.png)

  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis 6 right-parenthesis equals 6 cubed plus 6 plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>6</mn><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis 6 right-parenthesis equals 6 cubed plus 6 plus 1](images/c03_661.png) is represented by polynomial  <math alttext="left-parenthesis x squared plus x right-parenthesis cubed plus left-parenthesis x squared plus x right-parenthesis plus 1 equals x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x Superscript 5 Baseline plus x cubed plus x cubed plus x squared plus x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>6</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis x squared plus x right-parenthesis cubed plus left-parenthesis x squared plus x right-parenthesis plus 1 equals x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x Superscript 5 Baseline plus x cubed plus x cubed plus x squared plus x plus 1](images/c03_662.png). Since  <math alttext="x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x Superscript 5 Baseline plus x cubed plus x cubed plus x squared plus x plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>6</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>0</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![x Superscript 6 Baseline plus x Superscript 5 Baseline plus x cubed plus x cubed plus x squared plus x plus 1 identical-to 0 m o d f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_663.png),  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis 6 right-parenthesis equals 0" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis 6 right-parenthesis equals 0](images/c03_664.png).

***Definition 3.39 Polynomial basis***: *given a polynomial*  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_665.png) *of degree* *m* *and irreducible in* *F[p]* *and* α *a root of*  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis](images/c03_666.png) *and* α *a primitive element in*  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m](images/c03_667.png)*, the set of polynomials*  <math alttext="StartSet 1 comma alpha Superscript 1 Baseline comma ellipsis comma alpha Superscript m minus 2 Baseline comma alpha Superscript m minus 1 Baseline EndSet" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><mo>&#8230;</mo><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow></math> ![StartSet 1 comma alpha Superscript 1 Baseline comma ellipsis comma alpha Superscript m minus 2 Baseline comma alpha Superscript m minus 1 Baseline EndSet](images/c03_668.png) *is called polynomial basis of*  <math alttext="upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mi>p</mi><mi>m</mi></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript p Sub Superscript m](images/c03_669.png).

**Example 3.34** Let us consider the extension field  <math alttext="upper F Subscript 2 cubed Baseline" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></msub><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript 2 cubed Baseline](images/c03_680.png) under the irreducible polynomial  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus x plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis equals x cubed plus x plus 1](images/c03_681.png) and check that  <math alttext="StartSet 1 comma alpha comma alpha squared EndSet" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>,</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow></math> ![StartSet 1 comma alpha comma alpha squared EndSet](images/c03_682.png) is a polynomial basis to  <math alttext="upper F Subscript 2 cubed" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript 2 cubed](images/c03_683.png).

Since α is a root of  <math alttext="f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis comma alpha cubed plus alpha plus 1 equals 0 right double arrow alpha cubed equals negative alpha minus 1 equals alpha plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>&#8658;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![f left-parenthesis x right-parenthesis comma alpha cubed plus alpha plus 1 equals 0 right double arrow alpha cubed equals negative alpha minus 1 equals alpha plus 1](images/c03_686.png).

The powers, till  <math alttext="2 cubed minus 2 comma of alpha" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;of&#160;</mtext><mi>&#945;</mi></mrow></math> ![2 cubed minus 2 comma of alpha](images/c03_687.png) give:

 <math alttext="alpha Superscript 0 Baseline equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>0</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![alpha Superscript 0 Baseline equals 1](images/c03_688.png)    <math alttext="alpha Superscript 1 Baseline equals alpha" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>&#945;</mi></mrow></math> ![alpha Superscript 1 Baseline equals alpha](images/c03_689.png)    <math alttext="alpha squared equals alpha squared" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![alpha squared equals alpha squared](images/c03_690.png)    <math alttext="alpha cubed equals alpha plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![alpha cubed equals alpha plus 1](images/c03_691.png)

 <math alttext="alpha Superscript 4 Baseline equals alpha left-parenthesis alpha plus 1 right-parenthesis equals alpha squared plus alpha" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>&#945;</mi></mrow></math> ![alpha Superscript 4 Baseline equals alpha left-parenthesis alpha plus 1 right-parenthesis equals alpha squared plus alpha](images/c03_692.png)  <math alttext="alpha Superscript 5 Baseline equals alpha left-parenthesis alpha squared plus alpha right-parenthesis equals alpha squared plus alpha plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>5</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>&#945;</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![alpha Superscript 5 Baseline equals alpha left-parenthesis alpha squared plus alpha right-parenthesis equals alpha squared plus alpha plus 1](images/c03_693.png)

 <math alttext="alpha Superscript 6 Baseline equals alpha left-parenthesis alpha squared plus alpha plus 1 right-parenthesis equals alpha squared plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>6</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![alpha Superscript 6 Baseline equals alpha left-parenthesis alpha squared plus alpha plus 1 right-parenthesis equals alpha squared plus 1](images/c03_694.png).

Hence,  <math alttext="upper F Subscript 2 cubed" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper F Subscript 2 cubed](images/c03_695.png) can be written in three forms:

ext>&#8201;</mtext><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#8195;</mtext><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><mtext>&#8201;</mtext><msup><mi>&#945;</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>&#945;</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo>}</mo></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable></math>
