Hence,  <math alttext="u equals 19" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>u</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>19</mn></mrow></math> ![u equals 19](images/c03_1895.png) and  <math alttext="v equals negative 101" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>101</mn></mrow></math> ![v equals negative 101](images/c03_1896.png).

***Exercise*** ***3.22***

Use the Extended Euclidean algorithm to find multiplicative inverse of  <math alttext="a m o d n" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>n</mi></mrow></math> ![a m o d n](images/c03_1897.png). We need to find *u* and *v* such that  <math alttext="n asterisk u plus a asterisk v equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>\*</mo><mi>u</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>\*</mo><mi>v</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![n asterisk u plus a asterisk v equals 1](images/c03_1898.png). Then,  <math alttext="v equals a Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d n" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></msup><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>n</mi></mrow></math> ![v equals a Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d n](images/c03_1899.png).

1.   <math alttext="13 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 31 equals question-mark" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>13</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>31</mn><mo>=</mo><mo>?</mo></mrow></math> ![13 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 31 equals question-mark](images/c03_1900.png)
    
    The steps of computation of  <math alttext="GCD left-parenthesis 31 comma 13 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mtext>GCD</mtext><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>31</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>13</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![GCD left-parenthesis 31 comma 13 right-parenthesis](images/c03_1901.png) are as follows:
    
    1^(st) step:  <math alttext="31 equals 13 asterisk 2 plus 5" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>31</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></math> ![31 equals 13 asterisk 2 plus 5](images/c03_1902.png)
    
    2^(nd) step:  <math alttext="13 equals 5 asterisk 2 plus 3" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>13</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></math> ![13 equals 5 asterisk 2 plus 3](images/c03_1903.png)
    
    3^(rd) step:  <math alttext="5 equals 3 asterisk 1 plus 2" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></math> ![5 equals 3 asterisk 1 plus 2](images/c03_1904.png)
    
    4^(th) step:  <math alttext="3 equals 2 asterisk 1 plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![3 equals 2 asterisk 1 plus 1](images/c03_1905.png)
    
    5^(th) step:  <math alttext="2 equals 2 asterisk 1 plus 0" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> ![2 equals 2 asterisk 1 plus 0](images/c03_1906.png)
    
    Thus,  <math alttext="GCD left-parenthesis 31 comma 13 right-parenthesis equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mtext>GCD</mtext><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>31</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>13</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![GCD left-parenthesis 31 comma 13 right-parenthesis equals 1](images/c03_1907.png)
    
    To find *u* and *v* such that  <math alttext="31 u plus 13 v equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>31</mn><mi>u</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>13</mn><mi>v</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![31 u plus 13 v equals 1](images/c03_1908.png), do backward calculations starting from the result of the 4^(th) step:
    
     <math alttext="1 equals left-parenthesis 3 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis 13 minus 2 asterisk 5 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis 13 minus 2 asterisk left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>31</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![1 equals left-parenthesis 3 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis 13 minus 2 asterisk 5 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis 13 minus 2 asterisk left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis](images/c03_1909.png)
    
     <math alttext="1 equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 5 minus 3 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>31</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>31</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![1 equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 2 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 5 minus 3 right-parenthesis](images/c03_1910.png)
    
     <math alttext="1 equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 3 right-parenthesis right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>31</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>31</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![1 equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 3 right-parenthesis right-parenthesis](images/c03_1911.png)
    
     <math alttext="1 equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 13 minus 2 asterisk 5 right-parenthesis right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>31</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>31</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![1 equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 13 minus 2 asterisk 5 right-parenthesis right-parenthesis](images/c03_1912.png)
    
     <math alttext="1 equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 13 minus 2 asterisk left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis right-parenthesis right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>31</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>31</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>13</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>31</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![1 equals left-parenthesis 5 asterisk 13 minus 2 asterisk 31 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 13 minus 2 asterisk left-parenthesis 31 minus 2 asterisk 13 right-parenthesis right-parenthesis right-parenthesis](images/c03_1913.png)
    
     <math alttext="1 equals 31 asterisk left-parenthesis negative 5 right-parenthesis plus 13 asterisk left-parenthesis 12 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>31</mn><mo>\*</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>13</mn><mo>\*</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>12</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![1 equals 31 asterisk left-parenthesis negative 5 right-parenthesis plus 13 asterisk left-parenthesis 12 right-parenthesis](images/c03_1914.png)
    
    Hence,  <math alttext="13 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 31 equals 12" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>13</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>31</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>12</mn></mrow></math> ![13 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 31 equals 12](images/c03_1915.png)
    
2.   <math alttext="111 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 4111 equals question-mark" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>111</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>4111</mn><mo>=</mo><mo>?</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></math> ![111 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 4111 equals question-mark](images/c03_1916.png)
    
    The steps of computation of  <math alttext="GCD left-parenthesis 4111 comma 111 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mtext>GCD</mtext><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4111</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>111</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![GCD left-parenthesis 4111 comma 111 right-parenthesis](images/c03_1917.png) are as follows:
    
    1^(st) step:  <math alttext="4111 equals 111 asterisk 37 plus 4" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>4111</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>111</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>37</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></math> ![4111 equals 111 asterisk 37 plus 4](images/c03_1918.png)
    
    2^(nd) step:  <math alttext="111 equals 4 asterisk 27 plus 3" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>111</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>27</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></math> ![111 equals 4 asterisk 27 plus 3](images/c03_1919.png)
    
    3^(rd) step:  <math alttext="4 equals 3 asterisk 1 plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![4 equals 3 asterisk 1 plus 1](images/c03_1920.png)
    
    4^(th) step:  <math alttext="1 equals 1 asterisk 1 plus 0" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> ![1 equals 1 asterisk 1 plus 0](images/c03_1921.png)
    
    Thus,  <math alttext="GCD left-parenthesis 4111 comma 111 right-parenthesis equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mtext>GCD</mtext><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4111</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>111</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![GCD left-parenthesis 4111 comma 111 right-parenthesis equals 1](images/c03_1922.png).
    
    To find *u* and *v* such that  <math alttext="111 u plus 4111 v equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>111</mn><mi>u</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4111</mn><mi>v</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![111 u plus 4111 v equals 1](images/c03_1923.png), do backward calculations starting from the result of the 3^(rd) step:
    
     <math alttext="1 equals left-parenthesis 4 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 3 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis 4111 minus 111 asterisk 37 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 111 minus 4 asterisk 27 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4111</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>111</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>37</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>111</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>27</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![1 equals left-parenthesis 4 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 3 right-parenthesis equals left-parenthesis 4111 minus 111 asterisk 37 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 111 minus 4 asterisk 27 right-parenthesis](images/c03_1924.png)
    
     <math alttext="1 equals left-parenthesis 4111 minus 111 asterisk 37 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 111 minus left-parenthesis 4111 minus 111 asterisk 37 right-parenthesis asterisk 27 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4111</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>111</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>37</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>111</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4111</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>111</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>37</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>\*</mo><mn>27</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![1 equals left-parenthesis 4111 minus 111 asterisk 37 right-parenthesis minus left-parenthesis 111 minus left-parenthesis 4111 minus 111 asterisk 37 right-parenthesis asterisk 27 right-parenthesis](images/c03_1925.png)
    
     <math alttext="1 equals left-parenthesis 28 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis 4111 right-parenthesis plus left-parenthesis negative 38 minus 37 asterisk 27 right-parenthesis asterisk 111" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>28</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>\*</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4111</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>38</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>37</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>27</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>\*</mo><mn>111</mn></mrow></math> ![1 equals left-parenthesis 28 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis 4111 right-parenthesis plus left-parenthesis negative 38 minus 37 asterisk 27 right-parenthesis asterisk 111](images/c03_1926.png)
    
     <math alttext="1 equals left-parenthesis 28 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis 4111 right-parenthesis plus left-parenthesis negative 1037 right-parenthesis asterisk 111" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>28</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>\*</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>4111</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1037</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>\*</mo><mn>111</mn></mrow></math> ![1 equals left-parenthesis 28 right-parenthesis asterisk left-parenthesis 4111 right-parenthesis plus left-parenthesis negative 1037 right-parenthesis asterisk 111](images/c03_1927.png).
    
    Hence,  <math alttext="111 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 4111 equals negative 1037 m o d 4111 equals 3074" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>111</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>4111</mn><mo>=</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1037</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>4111</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>3074</mn></mrow></math> ![111 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 4111 equals negative 1037 m o d 4111 equals 3074](images/c03_1928.png).

     <math alttext="upper L equals 8 comma k 7 equals 1 comma k 6 equals 0 comma k 5 equals 1 comma k 4 equals 0 comma k 3 equals 0 comma k 2 equals 1 comma k 1 equals 0 comma k 0 equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>L</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>7</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>6</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>5</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>4</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper L equals 8 comma k 7 equals 1 comma k 6 equals 0 comma k 5 equals 1 comma k 4 equals 0 comma k 3 equals 0 comma k 2 equals 1 comma k 1 equals 0 comma k 0 equals 1](images/c03_1931.png)
    
     <math alttext="b 0 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 Super Superscript 0 Superscript Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 147 m o d 23 identical-to 9" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>0</mn></msup></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>147</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow></math> ![b 0 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 Super Superscript 0 Superscript Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 147 m o d 23 identical-to 9](images/c03_1932.png)
    
     <math alttext="b 1 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 0 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 Super Superscript 1 Superscript Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mn>0</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>1</mn></msup></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![b 1 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 0 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 Super Superscript 1 Superscript Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 1](images/c03_1933.png)
    
     <math alttext="b 2 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 squared Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 147 Superscript 4 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 m o d 23 right-parenthesis Superscript 4 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 6" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mn>4</mn></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>147</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>4</mn></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>6</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></math> ![b 2 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 squared Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 147 Superscript 4 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 m o d 23 right-parenthesis Superscript 4 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 6](images/c03_1934.png)

     <math alttext="147 Superscript 165 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 9 asterisk 1 asterisk 6 asterisk 1 asterisk 1 asterisk 18 asterisk 1 asterisk 4 m o d 23 identical-to 3888 m o d 23 identical-to 1 period" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>165</mn></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>18</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>4</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>3888</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mo>.</mo></mrow></math> ![147 Superscript 165 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 9 asterisk 1 asterisk 6 asterisk 1 asterisk 1 asterisk 18 asterisk 1 asterisk 4 m o d 23 identical-to 3888 m o d 23 identical-to 1 period](images/c03_1940.png)
    
2.  Fermat’s little theorem states that if *p* is prime and *a* is an integer not divisible by  <math alttext="p" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>p</mi></mrow></math> ![p](images/c03_1941.png), then  <math alttext="a Superscript p minus 1 Baseline identical-to 1 m o d p" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>a</mi><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>p</mi></mrow></math> ![a Superscript p minus 1 Baseline identical-to 1 m o d p](images/c03_1942.png).
    
    By Fermat’s little theorem,  <math alttext="147 Superscript 22 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>22</mn></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![147 Superscript 22 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 1](images/c03_1943.png), because 147 is not divisible by 23.
    
    Also,  <math alttext="147 Superscript 22 asterisk 7 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>22</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![147 Superscript 22 asterisk 7 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 1](images/c03_1944.png).
    
    Thus,  <math alttext="147 Superscript 165 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 22 asterisk 7 Baseline right-parenthesis left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 165 minus 22 asterisk 7 Baseline right-parenthesis m o d 23 identical-to 1 Superscript 7 Baseline asterisk 147 Superscript 11 Baseline m o d 23" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>165</mn></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>22</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>165</mn><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>22</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mn>1</mn><mn>7</mn></msup><mo>\*</mo><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>11</mn></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn></mrow></math> ![147 Superscript 165 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 22 asterisk 7 Baseline right-parenthesis left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 165 minus 22 asterisk 7 Baseline right-parenthesis m o d 23 identical-to 1 Superscript 7 Baseline asterisk 147 Superscript 11 Baseline m o d 23](images/c03_1945.png).
    
    Then, solve  <math alttext="147 Superscript 11 Baseline m o d 23" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>11</mn></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn></mrow></math> ![147 Superscript 11 Baseline m o d 23](images/c03_1946.png) using the right-to-left binary exponentiation method.
    
     <math alttext="11 equals 8 plus 2 plus 1 equals 2 cubed plus 2 plus 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>11</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![11 equals 8 plus 2 plus 1 equals 2 cubed plus 2 plus 1](images/c03_1947.png)
    
     <math alttext="upper L equals 4 comma k 3 equals 1 comma k 2 equals 0 comma k 1 equals 1 comma k 0 equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>L</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>k</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper L equals 4 comma k 3 equals 1 comma k 2 equals 0 comma k 1 equals 1 comma k 0 equals 1](images/c03_1948.png)
    
     <math alttext="b 0 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 Super Superscript 0 Superscript Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 147 m o d 23 identical-to 9" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>0</mn></msup></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>147</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow></math> ![b 0 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 Super Superscript 0 Superscript Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 147 m o d 23 identical-to 9](images/c03_1949.png)
    
     <math alttext="b 1 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 Super Superscript 1 Superscript Baseline m o d 23 identical-to left-parenthesis 9 right-parenthesis squared m o d 23 identical-to 12" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>1</mn></msup></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>12</mn></mrow></math> ![b 1 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 Super Superscript 1 Superscript Baseline m o d 23 identical-to left-parenthesis 9 right-parenthesis squared m o d 23 identical-to 12](images/c03_1950.png)
    
     <math alttext="b 2 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 0 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 squared Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 1 m o d 23" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mn>0</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn></mrow></math> ![b 2 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 0 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 squared Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 1 m o d 23](images/c03_1951.png)
    
     <math alttext="b 3 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 cubed Baseline m o d 23 identical-to left-parenthesis 12 right-parenthesis Superscript 4 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 13" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>12</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mn>4</mn></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>13</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext></mrow></math> ![b 3 identical-to left-parenthesis 147 Superscript 1 Baseline right-parenthesis Superscript 2 cubed Baseline m o d 23 identical-to left-parenthesis 12 right-parenthesis Superscript 4 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 13](images/c03_1952.png)
    
     <math alttext="147 Superscript 165 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 9 asterisk 12 asterisk 1 asterisk 13 m o d 23 identical-to 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mrow><mn>147</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>165</mn></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>12</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>13</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>23</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![147 Superscript 165 Baseline m o d 23 identical-to 9 asterisk 12 asterisk 1 asterisk 13 m o d 23 identical-to 1](images/c03_1953.png).
    
    Therefore, using Fermat’s little theorem before applying the binary exponentiation algorithm reduces significantly the number of squaring and multiplication operations.
    

***Exercise*** ***3.24***

 <math alttext="upper N equals 50021" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>50021</mn></mrow></math> ![upper N equals 50021](images/c03_1954.png),  <math alttext="upper X equals 15063" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>15063</mn></mrow></math> ![upper X equals 15063](images/c03_1955.png),  <math alttext="upper Y equals 37551" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>Y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>37551</mn></mrow></math> ![upper Y equals 37551](images/c03_1956.png), Base  <math alttext="upper B equals 16" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></mrow></math> ![upper B equals 16](images/c03_1957.png).

Hexadecimal representation of arguments:

 <math alttext="upper N equals 50021 Subscript 10 Baseline equals upper C 365 Subscript 16" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mrow><mn>50021</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>C</mi><msub><mrow><mn>365</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper N equals 50021 Subscript 10 Baseline equals upper C 365 Subscript 16](images/c03_1958.png)

 <math alttext="upper X equals 15063 Subscript 10 Baseline equals 3 upper A upper D 7 Subscript 16" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mrow><mn>15063</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>A</mi><mi>D</mi><msub><mn>7</mn><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper X equals 15063 Subscript 10 Baseline equals 3 upper A upper D 7 Subscript 16](images/c03_1959.png),  <math alttext="upper Y equals 37551 Subscript 10 Baseline equals 92 upper A upper F 16" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>Y</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mrow><mn>37551</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>92</mn><mi>A</mi><msub><mi>F</mi><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></math> ![upper Y equals 37551 Subscript 10 Baseline equals 92 upper A upper F 16](images/c03_1960.png)

*X* is four 16-bit words:  <math alttext="upper X equals left-parenthesis 3 comma 10 comma 13 comma 7 right-parenthesis" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>10</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>13</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>7</mn></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper X equals left-parenthesis 3 comma 10 comma 13 comma 7 right-parenthesis](images/c03_1961.png). Words are in decimal representation to make the computations by hand easy.

We keep  <math alttext="upper R equals 16 Superscript 4" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow><mn>4</mn></msup></mrow></math> ![upper R equals 16 Superscript 4](images/c03_1962.png), which meets the conditions  <math alttext="upper R ampersand gt semicolon upper N" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>&#38;gt;</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow></math> ![upper R ampersand gt semicolon upper N](images/c03_1963.png) and  <math alttext="upper G upper C upper D left-parenthesis upper R comma upper N right-parenthesis equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>G</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>N</mi></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper G upper C upper D left-parenthesis upper R comma upper N right-parenthesis equals 1](images/c03_1964.png).

 <math alttext="upper R equals 16 Superscript 4 Baseline equals 16 Superscript l Baseline right double arrow l equals 4" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow><mi>l</mi></msup><mo>&#8658;</mo><mi>l</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></math> ![upper R equals 16 Superscript 4 Baseline equals 16 Superscript l Baseline right double arrow l equals 4](images/c03_1965.png).

Compute  <math alttext="upper N prime equals minus upper N Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d upper B" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>N</mi><mo>&#8242;</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mi>N</mi><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>B</mi></mrow></math> ![upper N prime equals minus upper N Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d upper B](images/c03_1966.png):  <math alttext="upper N prime equals minus 50021 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 16 equals negative 13 m o d 16 equals 3" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mi>N</mi><mo>&#8242;</mo></msup><mo>=</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msup><mrow><mn>50021</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>16</mn><mo>=</mo><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>13</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>16</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></math> ![upper N prime equals minus 50021 Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d 16 equals negative 13 m o d 16 equals 3](images/c03_1967.png).

Below are the computations in multi-precision Montgomery multiplication:

![](images/c03_1968.png)

The multi-precision Montgomery multiplication returns 30902, which represents  <math alttext="upper X asterisk upper Y asterisk upper R Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d upper N" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo>\*</mo><mi>Y</mi><mo>\*</mo><msup><mi>R</mi><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>N</mi></mrow></math> ![upper X asterisk upper Y asterisk upper R Superscript negative 1 Baseline m o d upper N](images/c03_1971.png). Multiplying by *R* yields  <math alttext="left-parenthesis upper X asterisk upper Y asterisk upper R Superscript negative 1 Baseline right-parenthesis asterisk upper R m o d upper N identical-to upper X asterisk upper Y m o d upper N" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo>\*</mo><mi>Y</mi><mo>\*</mo><msup><mi>R</mi><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>)</mo><mo>\*</mo><mi>R</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>N</mi><mo>&#8801;</mo><mi>X</mi><mo>\*</mo><mi>Y</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>N</mi></mrow></math> ![left-parenthesis upper X asterisk upper Y asterisk upper R Superscript negative 1 Baseline right-parenthesis asterisk upper R m o d upper N identical-to upper X asterisk upper Y m o d upper N](images/c03_1972.png)

Thus,  <math alttext="30902 asterisk 16 Superscript 4 Baseline m o d 50021 equals 15063 asterisk 37551 m o d 50021 identical-to 43266" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mn>30902</mn><mo>\*</mo><msup><mrow><mn>16</mn></mrow><mn>4</mn></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>50021</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>15063</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>37551</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>50021</mn><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>43266</mn></mrow></math> ![30902 asterisk 16 Superscript 4 Baseline m o d 50021 equals 15063 asterisk 37551 m o d 50021 identical-to 43266](images/c03_1973.png).

***Exercise*** ***3.25***

Let us consider the following congruence system:

 <math alttext="upper S equals left-brace StartLayout 1st Row x identical-to 3 m o d 5 2nd Row x identical-to 1 m o d 7 3rd Row x identical-to 6 m o d 8 EndLayout" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>S</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>{</mo><mrow><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mtable columnalign="left"><mtr columnalign="left"><mtd columnalign="left"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>3</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>5</mn></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr columnalign="left"><mtd columnalign="left"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>7</mn></mrow></mtd></mtr><mtr columnalign="left"><mtd columnalign="left"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>6</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>8</mn></mrow></mtd></mtr></mtable></mrow></mrow></mrow></math> ![upper S equals left-brace StartLayout 1st Row x identical-to 3 m o d 5 2nd Row x identical-to 1 m o d 7 3rd Row x identical-to 6 m o d 8 EndLayout](images/c03_1974.png)

The constants of the congruence equation system are:

 <math alttext="n 1 equals 5 comma n 2 equals 7 comma n 3 equals 8" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>n</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>n</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow></math> ![n 1 equals 5 comma n 2 equals 7 comma n 3 equals 8](images/c03_1975.png)  <math alttext="a 1 equals 3 comma a 2 equals 1 comma a 3 equals 6" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></math> ![a 1 equals 3 comma a 2 equals 1 comma a 3 equals 6](images/c03_1976.png).

All  <math alttext="n Subscript i Baseline single-comma-quotation-mark s are pairwise coprime and a Subscript i Baseline less-than n Subscript i Baseline comma for i equals 1 comma 2 comma 3 period" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mtext>&#8217;s&#160;are&#160;pairwise&#160;coprime&#160;and&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>&#60;</mo><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;for&#160;</mtext><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3.</mn></mrow></math> ![n Subscript i Baseline single-comma-quotation-mark s are pairwise coprime and a Subscript i Baseline less-than n Subscript i Baseline comma for i equals 1 comma 2 comma 3 period](images/c03_1977.png) Thus, the conditions to use the Chinese remainder theorem are met.

Steps of calculation of *x* using Gauss’s algorithm:

Common modulus  <math alttext="upper N equals 5 asterisk 7 asterisk 8 equals 280" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>\*</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>280</mn></mrow></math> ![upper N equals 5 asterisk 7 asterisk 8 equals 280](images/c03_1978.png).

 <math alttext="upper N 1 equals StartFraction 280 Over 5 EndFraction equals 56 comma upper N 2 equals StartFraction 280 Over 7 EndFraction equals 40 comma upper N 3 equals StartFraction 280 Over 8 EndFraction equals 35" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msub><mi>N</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>280</mn></mrow><mn>5</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>56</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>N</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>280</mn></mrow><mn>7</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>40</mn><mo>,</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msub><mi>N</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>280</mn></mrow><mn>8</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>35</mn></mrow></math> ![upper N 1 equals StartFraction 280 Over 5 EndFraction equals 56 comma upper N 2 equals StartFraction 280 Over 7 EndFraction equals 40 comma upper N 3 equals StartFraction 280 Over 8 EndFraction equals 35](images/c03_1979.png)

Multiplicative inverses:

 <math alttext="upper N 1 Superscript negative 1 Baseline asterisk upper N 1 identical-to 1 m o d 5 right double arrow upper N 1 Superscript negative 1 Baseline equals 1" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msubsup><mi>N</mi><mn>1</mn><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><mo>\*</mo><msub><mi>N</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>5</mn><mo>&#8658;</mo><msubsup><mi>N</mi><mn>1</mn><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math> ![upper N 1 Superscript negative 1 Baseline asterisk upper N 1 identical-to 1 m o d 5 right double arrow upper N 1 Superscript negative 1 Baseline equals 1](images/c03_1980.png)   <math alttext="upper N 2 Superscript negative 1 Baseline asterisk upper N 2 identical-to 1 m o d 7 right double arrow upper N 2 Superscript negative 1 Baseline equals 3" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msubsup><mi>N</mi><mn>2</mn><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><mo>\*</mo><msub><mi>N</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>7</mn><mo>&#8658;</mo><msubsup><mi>N</mi><mn>2</mn><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></math> ![upper N 2 Superscript negative 1 Baseline asterisk upper N 2 identical-to 1 m o d 7 right double arrow upper N 2 Superscript negative 1 Baseline equals 3](images/c03_1981.png)

 <math alttext="upper N 3 Superscript negative 1 Baseline asterisk upper N 3 identical-to 1 m o d 8 right double arrow upper N 3 Superscript negative 1 Baseline equals 3" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msubsup><mi>N</mi><mn>3</mn><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><mo>\*</mo><msub><mi>N</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>8</mn><mo>&#8658;</mo><mtext>&#160;</mtext><msubsup><mi>N</mi><mn>3</mn><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></math> ![upper N 3 Superscript negative 1 Baseline asterisk upper N 3 identical-to 1 m o d 8 right double arrow upper N 3 Superscript negative 1 Baseline equals 3](images/c03_1982.png)

 <math alttext="x equals left-parenthesis sigma-summation Underscript i equals 1 Overscript 4 Endscripts left-parenthesis a Subscript i Baseline asterisk upper N Subscript i Baseline asterisk upper N Subscript i Superscript negative 1 Baseline right-parenthesis right-parenthesis m o d upper N" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><mstyle displaystyle="true"><msubsup><mo>&#8721;</mo><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mn>4</mn></msubsup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>\*</mo><msub><mi>N</mi><mi>i</mi></msub><mo>\*</mo><msubsup><mi>N</mi><mi>i</mi><mrow><mo>&#8722;</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msubsup></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mstyle></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>N</mi></mrow></math> ![x equals left-parenthesis sigma-summation Underscript i equals 1 Overscript 4 Endscripts left-parenthesis a Subscript i Baseline asterisk upper N Subscript i Baseline asterisk upper N Subscript i Superscript negative 1 Baseline right-parenthesis right-parenthesis m o d upper N](images/c03_1983.png)

     <math alttext="identical-to 2 asterisk left-parenthesis 1 right-parenthesis Superscript StartFraction 72 000 000 000 012 Over 2 EndFraction Baseline m o d 3 equals 2" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>\*</mo><msup><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>72</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>000</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>000</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>000</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>012</mn></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow></msup><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></math> ![identical-to 2 asterisk left-parenthesis 1 right-parenthesis Superscript StartFraction 72 000 000 000 012 Over 2 EndFraction Baseline m o d 3 equals 2](images/c03_1991.png) (because  <math alttext="2 squared identical-to 1 m o d 3" display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>&#8801;</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mtext>&#160;</mtext><mn>3</mn></mrow></math> ![2 squared identical-to 1 m o d 3](images/c03_1992.png))
